key_idea: Maintain a decreasing stack: each element popped by the new element forms a pair with it, and the element left on top (the first taller one to the left) forms one more.
sketch: Scan left to right keeping a stack of heights in decreasing order. For the new height d, pop every smaller element counting one pair each, then if the stack is non-empty count one more pair with the top, then push d. Heights are distinct so no equal-height handling is needed. O(n) with n up to 1e6; the answer is below 2n but use long long anyway and fast input.
